# Templates

Small templates for repeatable research workflow artifacts.

## Files

- `codex_execution_spec.md`: create one before substantial implementation or
  long experiment launches.
- `experiment_closeout.md`: use after a run when an autogenerated report is not
  enough to capture interpretation and next decisions.
